title: Dialkylated dibenzo[a,h]anthracenes for solution-processable organic thin-film transistors
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36390-36397
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07439D, Paper
Open Access

Tengzhou Yang, Liang Zhang, Yucong Bao, Haoming Wei
Here, two alkylated dibenzo[a,h]anthracene (DBA) derivatives with linear n-dodecyl (C12-DBA-C12) and ring-containing pentyl-cyclohexyl (Cy5-DBA-Cy5) moieties were successfully synthesized.
